meaning: Elect Open Access: hybrid product issued by Health Net of California, Inc. Members pick a PCP from the HMO network (HMO option) and may also see specialists in the PPO Network without referral (PPO option). Not a PPO plan, but it uses the PPO network for specialist care.
evidence: Health Net EOA employer flyer 2025 (FLY057815EP01 1/25): https://healthnet.com/content/dam/centene/healthnet/pdfs/broker/ca/general/hn-eoa-oe-flyer-2025.pdf. Data: 65 of 106 employers offering EOA also offer an HMO and a PPO. Team decision 2026-10-17: non-PPO; its main network is the HMO network (A7).

meaning: Salud con Health Net: Salud HMO y Mas, an HMO issued by Health Net of California, Inc., with care in Mexico through SIMNSA (a Mexican prepaid plan). 'SAL Mex' = Salud Mexico.
evidence: Health Net Salud broker flyer (FLY1566908EL01w 6/24): https://wordandbrown.com/getmedia/33d764b4-b489-43c5-badb-6e6313a1655c/hn-broker-salud-flyer-2025_1.pdf. Data: 151 California plans already say SAL HMO.
